digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter and capability system
propositions: Epic-field capability-map reports must be validated post-run and refuse vouch if unverifiable, exiting non-zero with verdict in run_metadata.json

Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded with isinstance-primary hasattr-fallback logic, reporting capability-absent vs capability-raised distinctly on bridge_alerts rather than swallowing failures silently
The dormant inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations) must be deleted, with the operator decision and reason recorded outside the repo
Capability-absent reports are designed skips for optional backends and must produce INFO logs and durable bridge_alerts records, not hard failures
Three unit modules (test_probe_capability.py and siblings) deleted alongside the port removal do not represent test weakening or cell removal to reach green
